description.fr-FR: Les mandements de Fénelon, archevêque de Cambrai, pour le jubilé, le carême et des prières publiques (1701-1713), avec le mandement latin sur l’édition du rituel. Les pièces relatives à la condamnation des Maximes et au jansénisme sont dans leurs classes.
description.en-US: The pastoral letters (mandements) of Fénelon, Archbishop of Cambrai, for the jubilee, Lent and public prayers (1701-1713), with the Latin mandate on the publication of the ritual. The documents on the condemnation of the Maxims and on Jansenism are in their own classes.
description.pt-BR: Os mandamentos de Fénelon, arcebispo de Cambrai, para o jubileu, a Quaresma e orações públicas (1701-1713), com o mandamento latino sobre a edição do ritual. As peças relativas à condenação das Máximas e ao jansenismo estão em suas próprias classes.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 6, p. 449–; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
